name: Trash
description: Notes deleted in the last 30 days (the trash.retentionDays setting), with who deleted them and the days each has left. Restore one (r, or swipe right) and it comes back where it was, with its history; delete one forever (D, or swipe left) or empty Trash, after it asks, and its text leaves history. A link to a note in Trash says so, with Restore.

history:read.why: List deleted notes, and show their last version

files:read.why: Know which version of a note you're moving to Trash

files:write.why: Move notes to Trash, restore them, and delete them forever when you say so, as changes by you

editor.why: Say so on links to a note that's in Trash
